semantics.identity_rule: Each SLO has an explicit canonical identity.
semantics.window_rule: Evaluation window and aggregation semantics are explicit.
semantics.threshold_rule: Pass/fail thresholds and error-budget semantics are explicit where used.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown/not-evaluated does not silently equal pass.
semantics.result_rule: Each evaluation produces distinct derived evidence identity.
semantics.authority_rule: SLO state is operational evidence and never data-access authority.

invariants.rule: Freshness, availability, completeness, latency and SLO results are derived service-health evidence over exact data/runtime scopes; they never change data identity, ownership, classification, authorization or execution authority.
